Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with a distal
radius fracture sustained when the arm was braced against the vehicle interior. The
mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported crash forces and the fracture
pattern seen on imaging. Radiographs clearly confirm the fracture, and physical
examination findings, including localized tenderness, swelling, and restricted wrist
motion, are in agreement with those images. There is no record of prior injury or
treatment to this wrist or forearm.
Care was delivered over 29 visits and followed a typical course for this injury:
initial immobilization and pain management, followed by serial imaging to confirm
alignment and healing, then a progressive therapy program to restore grip strength and
range of motion. Visit frequency decreased steadily as function improved and pain
resolved. Billing records reflect the scheduled treatment with no duplicate or
repeated charges for the same services.
At discharge the patient has near-full range of motion, improved grip strength, and is
returning to daily activities. Ongoing home exercises and a follow-up review have been
recommended.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
